title: FizzBuzz Single
description:
Given a single number `n`, return `'FizzBuzz'` if divisible by both 3 and 5, `'Fizz'` if divisible by 3, `'Buzz'` if divisible by 5, or the number as a string otherwise.

**Example:**
```
fizzbuzz(15) → 'FizzBuzz'
fizzbuzz(9) → 'Fizz'
fizzbuzz(10) → 'Buzz'
fizzbuzz(7) → '7'
```
hint: Check divisibility by both 3 and 5 FIRST, before checking each individually.
